items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: Because Tommy Darcy, he recorded with the big man.

ctx.x: Doctor, I'll find you one. You've got a cassette player? Yeah. I'll put it on cassette for you. We've got some place up here. Somewhere we've got pine top boogie woogie woogie.

Yeah, that's really good, man. He used to play it, man. Man, I used to sit down and just look at him. Because Tommy Darcy, he recorded with the big man. But it's not like when you play it on the piano. Yeah, on the piano, man. My uncle used to play the devil out that thing, man. Yeah.

Yeah, that was a, well, I think we're almost out of tape. For a guy who couldn't remember anything, you sure were able to remember a lot. Well. Let me, let me, let me make some copies, do some Xerox of this. Okay, all right. Of all these little things. Okay. And like stuff on Hosey. Yeah, okay. In fact, let me show you. It's almost out. Okay. A couple of photographs we wanted to show you. Let me show you. Right here. Let me do some. Okay.
